data.gender_notes: Gulala is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'gul' meaning 'rose', Gulala represents the delicate beauty and promise of a budding rose. In Islamic tradition, roses symbolize love, compassion, and divine grace. The name Gulala carries the meaning “Rosebud” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Gulala usually hope their child will grow to embody rosebud and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of divine love and compassion in Islam.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Gulala total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
